acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce, or close as not reproduced with the measured argv and output
If it reproduces, context names the worktree HEAD or explicitly reports index staleness
body: Friction from the store-lease-writer lane (2026-10-21, branch claude/batch-store-lease-writer, base 90ab9f33e). Suspected defect, not confirmed: the lane reported that `corvint context` in its worktree (HEAD at base 90ab9f33e) named revision 590ebc70. Possible causes: a stale index pinned to an older tree, or root resolution reaching another checkout. Needs a reproduction with the exact argv and the index state.
title: Suspected: corvint context reports a revision other than the lane worktree HEAD
